newsitem.title: USA: Ceridian buys cash advance service company.
newsitem.headline: Ceridian buys cash advance service company.

text.p: Ceridian Corp said Friday it acquired Premier CashLink, a provider of cash advance services to the gaming industry, from Service Data Corp.
Terms of the transaction were not disclosed. Premier CashLink had 1996 revenues of about $16 million.
Premier CashLink provides credit card cash advances at gaming properties. It will be integrated into Ceridian's Comdata.

"We expect the merging of Premier CashLink into Comdata to enhance Comdata's position in the casino market and strengthen our presence in the pari-mutuel market," said Tony Holcombe, president and chief executive officer of Comdata.
Ceridian is an information services and defense electronics company serving the human resources, electronic media, transportation, gaming and government markets.
